3592f7f4810a57e0c4d057d787f12c4340123b86: A resort on a human scale, Saint-Martin-de-Belleville prides itself on the quality of its welcome and its closeness rather than on impressive figures. Its 40 km of runs are a perfect fit for a 3 to 4 day stay, especially for families or skiers who do not need to constantly renew their playground. The DNA of Saint-Martin-de-Belleville is upmarket: the accommodation, the mountain restaurants and the resort services reflect a clientele that does not count the cost. With a day lift pass at 67€, the stay comes at a price, but the experience lives up to it for anyone who wants to indulge without compromise. The altitude of Saint-Martin-de-Belleville (1450 m at the bottom, 2400 m at the top) allows it to maintain decent snow cover in the depths of winter. January and February are the most reliable months; in December and March, it is best to check conditions before finalising a booking. The budget for a stay in Saint-Martin-de-Belleville is clearly high: 67€ for a day lift pass, plus accommodation and mountain restaurants among the most expensive in the Alps. It is the price of excellence, but you should be aware of it before you go. In short, Saint-Martin-de-Belleville is not for everyone, but for those who can afford it, it is probably one of the best skiing experiences in Europe.
